canonicalDecision: The HNK Mandala uses a factorized primitive addressing model. Visible composite cells are not automatically independent Atomic-Kodes.
principle: An Atomic-Kode identifies a reusable primitive coordinate/function in the Mandala graph. A Mandala Field may be a composition of Atomic-Kodes. A glyph is an ordered path over typed primitive and composite addresses.

namespaces.meaning: central white field / five-petal rose / green rays / gold-cross primitives
namespaces.reason: Core sub-primitives require a separate topology decision and are not needed to address the frozen 109 primitive substrate.

canonicalPrimitiveSubstrate.flatAKNumberingPolicy: AK-001..AK-109 may be assigned deterministically only as an alias layer over typed IDs; typed IDs remain primary authority.

majorLayout.meaning: canonical major address-space count with CORE excluded

encodingLaw: BIN/HEX/QR/Pixel/IsoPixel/Voxel encodings must preserve namespace/type plus identity. A flat integer alone is not a lossless canonical address unless accompanied by a versioned decoding table.
glyphLaw: A canonical HNK glyph must ultimately be representable as an ordered, versioned, reversible PATH through Mandala addresses; visual rendering is a projection of that path, not the authority itself.
next: Generate deterministic AK-001..AK-109 alias registry, topology/neighbor graph, binary+hex typed encoding and Pixel/IsoPixel projection contracts while semantic extraction continues in parallel.
